projects.name: RiverGuard
projects.description: RiverGuard is a smart river contamination reporting and downstream impact detection system. It allows citizens to report pollution, traces how the risk may travel through the river network, identifies affected settlements and water sources, and helps authorities review, verify, and respond to incidents more effectively.
